scoring_justification: T1 recompute of η_H and μ_ph from the agent's reported parameters to verify self-consistency; final μ_ph compared to paper's hidden reference value with tolerance. Intermediate parameter checks use piecewise-linear tolerances reflecting DFT accuracy.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for μ_ph, target values for Eu_mode_frequency, β/a, v_F, and physical constants needed for recomputation.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text, Fig. 2 and supplemental material; verified by recomputation from the reported parameters using Eqs. (S36)-(S38) and Eq. (8).
hidden_assets.generation_method: The μ_ph gold is the paper's reported value at τ=0.1 ps, B=1 T, ε_F=0.1 eV. Target values for intermediate parameters are extracted from the paper (0.6 THz, 632 Å⁻¹, 10⁶ m/s). Physical constants are standard CODATA values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All values are traceable to the paper's reported results and formula; the reference solve.sh reproduces the hidden gold exactly, confirming internal consistency with the paper's physics.

schema.description: CSV with rows for each computed quantity; value column holds the numeric result, unit column the corresponding unit. Expected parameter names: Eu_mode_frequency, beta_over_a, v_F, eta_H, mu_ph, omega_plus, omega_minus.

outputs.description: Set of computed quantities derived from the DFT pipeline that constitute the phonon magnetic moment and its supporting parameters.

output_contract.notes: The checker will recompute mu_ph from the reported β/a, v_F, and η_H to verify internal consistency and will compare the final mu_ph to a hidden paper‑reported reference value with a tolerance. Other rows are audited for completeness.
